meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

copy.tagline: 绑定超工作模式指令到代码编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Codex中启用ultrawork模式指令。
copy.tagline_en: Bind ultrawork mode directive to Codex editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enable ultrawork mode directive in Codex.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会进入“超工作模式”，严格按规则执行任务：先调查、再规划、然后测试驱动开发，每一步都要记录证据，直到所有验收条件通过。
howto.when: 当你的提示词中包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式帮我修复这个 bug。
say.note: Claude 会启动超工作模式，按规则执行修复。

say.text: ulw 模式下添加一个新 API 端点。
say.note: Claude 会先调查现有代码，再规划并实现。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude enters 'ultrawork mode' and follows strict rules: survey skills, plan, test-driven development, capture evidence for every step, and stop only when all success criteria pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'.

say_en.text: Fix this bug in ultrawork mode.
say_en.note: Claude will start ultrawork mode and follow the rules to fix it.

say_en.text: Add a new API endpoint under ulw mode.
say_en.note: Claude will survey existing code, plan, and implement.
